note: Date of service, per page. (1) Key/value: the DOS dates the extractor accepted (staging/extraction.json), never a print key's, grouped by their tier; the page takes the first group in kv_priority for its kind (page classification L1, page_kinds) and within it the highest score; weak dates need a score above weak_min_score; a discharge page pairs Admit (From) with Discharge (To). (2) Only when key/value has no date, a label below that starts within the first or last edge_words words of the page, with a date right after it (within label_reach_chars, only label_gap_words words between, so 'Visit Date: | DOB: 01/02/1960' is not a DOS; never a date after D:, T:, DD:, DT:, TD:, TT:, Dictated or Transcribed) — an encounter label wins, else admit is From and discharge To. (3) Other pages only: the dictated date, else the transcribed one. Otherwise no date. Edit labels here, not in dos_logic.py. Reloads on change.
note_default: DOS_DEFAULT_DATE is shown for a page with no date of its own (doc-level columns, review-ui downloads). It is never a page's Extracted DOS; it is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos).
note_confidence: kv is used only for a key/value date with no score (staging from before the model ran); a scored date carries the model's own score. edge is every edge-keyword date.
note_weak_min_score: A weak key's date (weak, weak_last: Date, Report Date, Service, dt, dd, ...) is a candidate only when its score (the model's, else the rules') is above this. No other tier has a floor: any score counts, and the score only orders dates within a group.
note_page_kinds: A page's kind is its page classification L1 (page_subtype stage, before DOS; a row without v24 axes gives its page_type): these names make it discharge or lab; any other, or no classification, is other. Laboratory Data is the pre-v24 page type for Lab Report/Result.
note_kv_priority: Which key/value date a page takes. Candidates are the DOS dates the extractor accepted (staging/extraction.json), grouped by the tier it gave them; a print key's date (tier printed) is never one, and a tier not listed for the page's kind is not one either. Discharge: the Admit / Discharge pair (From = admit, To = the discharge on or after it, one alone is both; an edge label fills a missing side), then Date of Service, then weak keys. Lab: Collected, then Received, then Report Date (report), then Date of Service, then weak. Other: Date of Service, then weak. Lab and other pages end with the Admit / Discharge pair, so a discharge page the classifier missed keeps its stay. weak_last = a weak key in weak_last_keys (dt, dd), after every other weak key; keyless = a date in the header / footer band with no key in front of it. Within a group the highest score wins (the model's, else the rules', then page order); a weak key's date (Report Date too) needs a score above weak_min_score. Only when no group has a date: the edge keyword, then (other pages) the dictated date.
